summary.title: Awesome CTO (Substack newsletter by Dima Kuchin)
summary.one_liner: Dima Kuchin's Substack newsletter that posts updates about the awesome-cto resource list on GitHub; the page itself shows only the archive of post titles and no substantive content.
takeaways: The newsletter provides updates to the awesome-cto resource list hosted on GitHub at github.com/kuchin/awesome-cto.
Archive posts include an intro, monthly updates (December 2022, March 2023), a text-to-SQL webinar announcement (April 2025), and an 'Awesome CEO' post.
The page text does not include the content of the resource list itself, so the list's actual entries are unknown from this page.
summary.summary: This is the Substack landing page for the Awesome CTO newsletter by Dima Kuchin, launched about four years before the page was captured. It lists a short archive of post titles and dates, from an intro in November 2022 through a text-to-SQL webinar in April 2025, and points readers to the GitHub resource list at github.com/kuchin/awesome-cto. The post bodies shown are mostly brief excerpts, and the page does not describe the resources in the list, so the content is sparse and the level is unknown.
